summary: Drop in whenever suits and stay as long as you like.

activities.title: Install fest
activities.description: Bring the laptop you already have and we'll help you put free software on it. USB sticks provided, plus blank ones to take home.

activities.title: Open exchange
activities.description: An open floor to talk about open source software. Beginner questions are the whole point, not an interruption.

activities.title: Lightning talks
activities.description: Short talks to finish the day. A few minutes each, and anyone in the room can give one.
